Name: Kenneth's Laboratory Vials
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Laboratory Vials[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]65 tiny lab vials for Kenneth's Potion Shop. Vials, tonics, reagents, and antidotes in all kinds of lab colors.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]65 vials spread across Shops 1-5, all with that little lab feel. Some are clear and calm, some are bright and fizzy, and a few are the kind you save for a long day. Test vials, sample vials, tonics, reagents, elixirs, and antidotes are in there, in azure, crimson, emerald, gold, and violet looks.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check all 5 shops in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Potion Shop - Shops 1-5[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You buy with gold, and a few need a blank vial or lab flask too, so bring those when you stop by.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Potion Shop, and check Shops 1-5.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Potion Shop - you need this so Shops 1-5 show up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Potion Shop is also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shops 1-5.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other potions from Kenneth's Potion Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
